briefs.text: Reusable water bottle ad: a hiker on a trail drinks from the bottle, then holds it up so the logo faces camera.
Lip balm UGC: a woman in a car applies the lip balm, looks at herself in the visor mirror, and smiles.
Two friends share a pizza on a couch and laugh. One reaches for the last slice.
Smartwatch ad: a runner glances at the watch on their wrist at the end of a run; the screen stays facing camera.
Hands-only candle ad: a hand lights a candle on a wooden shelf; the label stays readable.
Yoga mat ad: three people stretch in a sunlit studio, all on matching mats, one holds a pose at the front.
Cold brew can ad: a can is opened with a visible fizz in a kitchen, then poured over ice.
Jacket ad: a model walks toward camera on a city street in light rain, jacket zipped, hood down.
Dog treats ad: a dog sits, an owner hands it one treat, and the dog eats it. Only one dog.
Phone case ad: a person flips a phone from front to back to show the case design; the design stays unchanged.
Gym class ad: four people do squats in unison at a window-lit studio; the camera starts wide and pushes in slowly.
Perfume bottle macro: the bottle rotates slowly on a reflective surface, light sweeping across the glass. No people.
